description: The figure is a two-level donut pie chart representing “Win rate (%)” for model comparisons, with two concentric rings that each contain 2 slices. In the outer ring, a large dark blue slice labeled “GPT-4o: 96.8%” occupies nearly the entire circle, while a small light blue slice labeled “LLaMA: 3.2%” fills the remaining portion; both labels are placed outside the ring with leader lines and no percentages are printed inside the slices. In the inner ring, a large dark red slice labeled “GPT-4o: 98.4%” similarly dominates the circle, and a very thin light/white slice (label not clearly readable in the image) occupies the small remainder; the inner ring also uses external callouts rather than internal percentage text. There is no separate legend, and no slices appear exploded or offset; the small slices are positioned near the top of the rings.
